pairs.why: B's slide fills slightly more of the card and runs off the bottom-right like the real slide, while A leaves a bit more empty wall at the top.
Rope scale, placement and margins are almost identical in A and B, so composition gives no reason to choose.
A's helmet is bigger and closer to the edges, like the real hero objects that fill most of the card, while B is smaller with more empty margin.
A's unit spans the card width and bleeds toward the left edge like the real one, while B is smaller and leaves more empty wall.
A's cooler is large and centered with tight margins, like the real hero, while B is wider and flatter and leaves more empty sky and sand.
B's calculator is slightly smaller and tilted off-axis with margin around it, closer to the real card's diagonal placement, though both are close.
A's mixer and headphones fill the card width and most of its height like the real card, while B is small and low with a large empty top.
A's truss runs across the full top edge and its light has a large, centered presence like the real card, while B's truss floats short and the light sits smaller.
